en-US.genreinfo.cards.title: Total War unit cards
en-US.genreinfo.controls.hint: Recall G1-G4 for 4X, MOBA, RTS squad, and barracks presets. Save G1-G4 snapshots the current viewed selection and mirrors it into formation view.
en-US.genreinfo.controls.title: Selection dock + control groups
en-US.genreinfo.header.body: One runtime covers localized portrait cards, mixed image-text insight briefs, and dense selection docks across 4X, RTS, and MOBA.
en-US.genreinfo.header.title: Genre Info Panel Showcase
en-US.genreinfo.profile.barracks.action.marine: Keep the train action readable at deck level.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.barracks.action.stim.b: Show upgrade timing without opening another panel.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.barracks.body: Structures share the same profile pipeline but focus on queues and upgrades.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.barracks.subtitle: Production spine for train and research intent.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.governor.action.coloni: Expose expansion legality in one glance.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.governor.body: 4X cards bias toward empire posture, economy, and frontier pressure.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.governor.subtitle: Strategic summary for long-horizon decisions.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.governor.tip.2: Sample live numbers from SoA attributes.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.q.body: Quick-cast damage spell with visible readiness.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.q.title: Void Lance
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.r.body: Ultimate pressure with a clear state pill.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.r.title: Astral Prison
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.w.body: Utility spell that demonstrates blocked state copy.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.w.title: Veil Shift
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.body: Portrait-first hero treatment follows SC2 and War3 readability: portrait, role, then a few critical actions and tips.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.subtitle: High-readability single-select portrait.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.hero.tip.2: Explain blocked buttons instead of hiding them.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.marine.action.stim.bod: Inline upgrade dependence for squad cards.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.marine.body: Unit cards compress survivability and throughput into a readable formation deck.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.marine.subtitle: Dense frontline card for grouped selections.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.marine.tip.2: Use category chips for repeated units.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.tank.action.aoe.body: Heavy support still reads in the same deck.

en-US.genreinfo.profile.tank.subtitle: Backline power card.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.tank.tip.1: Differentiate support armor from line units.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.tank.tip.2: Accent and glyph shifts are enough.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.vessel.action.aura.bod: Read aura support as persistent coverage.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.vessel.action.irradiat: Support casters share the same action-state pipeline.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.vessel.body: Support craft cards surface resource pressure and utility context.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.vessel.subtitle: Support vessel card for mixed-arms decks.
en-US.genreinfo.profile.vessel.tip.2: Reuse portrait + chip + stat line across genres.

zh-CN.genreinfo.cards.title: 全战风格兵牌
zh-CN.genreinfo.controls.hint: G1-G4 分别召回 4X、MOBA、RTS 战群和兵营预设。保存 G1-G4 会把当前视图快照写入控制组，并同步到编队视图。
zh-CN.genreinfo.controls.title: 选中坞舱与控制组
zh-CN.genreinfo.header.body: 同一条运行时链路，同时覆盖 4X、RTS、MOBA 的多语言头像卡、图文 insight 简报和高密度选中坞舱。
zh-CN.genreinfo.header.title: 题材信息面板 Showcase
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.barracks.action.marine: 在卡组层直接读懂训练动作。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.barracks.action.stim.b: 不切面板也能看见升级时机。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.barracks.body: 建筑沿用同一套 profile 管线，但重点放在队列和升级。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.barracks.subtitle: 承载训练与研究意图的产线骨架。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.governor.action.coloni: 一眼看懂扩张是否合法。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.governor.action.tech.b: 把科研压力和经济面放在一起。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.governor.body: 4X 卡片优先呈现帝国姿态、经济和边疆压力。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.governor.subtitle: 面向长线决策的战略摘要。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.governor.tip.2: 实时数值从 SoA 属性缓冲采样。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.q.body: 带就绪状态的快施法伤害技能。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.q.title: 虚空长枪
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.r.body: 大招压力用清晰状态胶囊表达。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.r.title: 星狱禁锢
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.w.body: 功能技能用受阻状态文案说明原因。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.action.w.title: 幕纱位移
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.body: 头像优先的英雄面板沿用 SC2 / War3 的阅读顺序：先头像，再角色定位，再少量关键动作与提示。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.subtitle: 高可读单选头像。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.hero.tip.2: 按钮受阻时给出解释，不要直接隐藏。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.marine.action.stim.bod: 在战群卡里直接说明升级依赖。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.marine.body: 兵牌把生存与输出压成可扫读的编队卡组。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.marine.subtitle: 服务多选的高密度前线兵牌。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.marine.tip.2: 重复单位用类别标签聚合。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.action.aoe.body: 重型支援依然留在同一张卡组里。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.action.aoe.title: 攻城溅射
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.body: 重装卡强调轮廓、爆发角色与就绪状态。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.subtitle: 后排火力卡。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.tip.1: 支援装甲要区别于线列单位。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.tank.tip.2: 换色和 glyph 已经足够。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.vessel.action.aura.bod: 把光环支援读成持续覆盖。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.vessel.action.irradiat: 辅助施法者也能走同一套动作状态管线。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.vessel.body: 支援飞船卡突出资源压力与功能上下文。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.vessel.subtitle: 混编卡组里的辅助飞船卡。
zh-CN.genreinfo.profile.vessel.tip.2: 头像、标签、数值行可以跨题材复用。
zh-CN.genreinfo.selection.title: 头像融合、单选头像与兵牌卡组
